angel._.mihai: Matthias Mihai reached S-F10 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Matthias Mihai, volunteer number 50, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.

Anselm Tom cut Matthias Mihai's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Matthias Mihai helped stack spare sandbags at S-F10. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
On sentry duty Matthias Mihai watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
A shell knocked in the parapet at S-F10. Matthias Mihai was dug out of the sandbags bruised, coughing, and furious.
averelle_3d: Nils Averelle told the sergeant he was a tram conductor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
Nils Averelle is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
The transfer made Nils Averelle a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Nils Averelle agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Nils Averelle watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A single shot from across the wire hit Nils Averelle in the thigh at R-F11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud).

Nils Averelle wrote half a letter home from bed, then tore it up. It said he was fine. It was not a convincing lie. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.
ghai.gpt: Ulrich Gpt introduced himself as a bookbinder from Brennmoor. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Ulrich Gpt's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.
The snipers took Ulrich Gpt in on a wet morning in R-F14. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.
Ulrich Gpt had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel "Mole" Freddie crossed it, Ulrich Gpt fired. Wendel "Mole" Freddie was badly wounded.

The cook borrowed Ulrich Gpt's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Ulrich Gpt could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Ulrich Gpt lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
